name: Todo
description: A todo list whose schema evolves from v1 to v2, used to demonstrate document model versioning

operations.name: ADD_ITEM
operations.reducer: state.items.push({ id: action.input.id, title: action.input.title, checked: false });

operations.name: CHECK_ITEM
operations.reducer:
const item = state.items.find((i) => i.id === action.input.id);
if (item) item.checked = action.input.checked;

operations.name: ADD_ITEM
operations.description: Append a new item with default status TODO.
operations.reducer: state.items.push({ id: action.input.id, title: action.input.title, status: 'TODO', priority: action.input.priority ?? 0 });

operations.name: CHECK_ITEM
operations.description: Legacy operation retained from v1 so historical logs still replay; maps checked onto status.
operations.reducer:
const item = state.items.find((i) => i.id === action.input.id);
if (item) item.status = action.input.checked ? 'DONE' : 'TODO';

operations.name: SET_STATUS
operations.reducer:
const item = state.items.find((i) => i.id === action.input.id);
if (item) item.status = action.input.status;

operations.name: SET_PRIORITY
operations.reducer:
const item = state.items.find((i) => i.id === action.input.id);
if (item) item.priority = action.input.priority;
